title: Corner to corner on a grid
notes: A 4 by 4 grid, from A in one corner to P in the other. Each side sweeps a diagonal band of the grid, and they meet on the middle diagonal.
ops: A-B, B-C, C-D, E-F, F-G, G-H, I-J, J-K, K-L, M-N, N-O, O-P, A-E, E-I, I-M, B-F, F-J, J-N, C-G, G-K, K-O, D-H, H-L, L-P
